claims.text: When an auth collection's oauth2 providers list is updated to add a new provider, already configured providers that are resubmitted without a clientSecret keep their previously stored clientSecret (the update succeeds and later updates of the collection still pass validation).
Updating the providers list keeps all submitted providers with their submitted names and clientIds, and a newly supplied clientSecret for a provider is accepted.
OAuth2 provider client secrets are never returned in collection API responses.
A provider omitted from a submitted providers list is removed from the collection configuration.
